job.title: Digital Infrastructure Traineeship
job.description:
About MobReady
MobReady are a socially inclusive, Supply Nation certified, Aboriginal owned Group Training Organisation with a commitment to connecting our Mob with a sustainable career through trainee & apprentice opportunities across NSW & ACT. As an Aboriginal organisation, we understand the importance of providing mentoring & support as you kickstart your new journey. 
 
 
The Role: 
The Infrastructure Trainee supports the Bank's Infrastructure team while completing a structured traineeship
program. The role provides practical experience across systems administration, server technologies,
virtualisation, network engineering and infrast ructure support services. The trainee develops foundational
technical knowledge and workplace skills to prepare for progression into Infrastructure Systems
Administration or Network Engineering roles.

Key Accountabilities

Infrastructure Support
- Assist with the operation, monitoring and maintenance of the Bank's technology infrastructure.
- Support routine maintenance, testing, upgrades and service delivery activities.
- Assist with investigating and resolving technology issues under guidance.
- Develop an understanding of server, network and security technologies.
 
Administration
- Maintain accurate records and technical documentation.
- Support reporting and administrative activities.
- Follow security, governance and change management processes.
 
Learning and Development
- Complete all requirements of the traineeship qualification.
- Participate in coaching, training and workplace learning activities.
- Build knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including servers, networks, operating systems and
virtualisation platforms.
- Apply learning from formal training in the workplace.
- Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. 
 
Selection Criteria:
- Identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander - Confirmation of Aboriginality or a stat dec is required.
- Genuine interest in technology
- Pass a police check
- Basic computer skills
- Completed year 12 or equivalent 

This is a targeted position under the anti-Discrimination Act 1977 persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply and preference for the role. 
 
If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW!

Brittney Simpson
Field Officer

job.title: Civil Construction Trainee
job.description:
About MobReady: 
MobReady is a socially inclusive Group Training Organisation (GTO) offering traineeship and apprenticeship opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. A recognised Supply Nation Certified business, our vision is to stimulate positive change by providing trainee and apprentice employment opportunities, supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture toward achieving sustainable outcomes.
 
The Role: 
We are actively seeking motivated First Nations candidates to kickstart your career as a Civil Construction Trainee, working across various projects in Sydney. Over the 3 years, you will work with a highly skilled team to learn all the tricks of the trade. 
 
You will gain electrical experience, whilst working on projects across Sydney and also completing a Cert III Civil Construction.
 
Immediate start available.
 
Work sites are across City of Sydney with depot located in Rockdale.
 
This role is targeted for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates only. 
 
FEMALE CANDIDATES STRONGLY ENCOURAGED TO APPLY!
 
The successful candidate will receive Culturally sensitive mentoring to ensure they have all the support necessary to succeed. 
 
Key Responsibilities:
Under the guidance and supervision of the qualified team, you will be required to carry out repairing, maintaining and installation works of electrical equipment in line with your training/apprenticeship level, as well as any other reasonable duties expected of an Electrical Apprentice.
 
Ideal Candidate Traits:
  • Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Female
  • Car & Licence
  • Pass a Police check (flexible)
  • Pass a Pre-Employment Medical including drug & alcohol
  • Previous experience will be an advantage but not essential!
  • White Card
 
This is a targeted position under the anti-Discrimination Act 1977 persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply and preference for the role. If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW! Please reach out to us for a yarn. 

Justin Biles
General Manager
